💡 fmx | Rust
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a simple, fast, and versatile desktop application for converting various media file types without requiring users to install multiple specialized tools.
✨ Key Features: • All-in-one media conversion (video, audio, image, PDF, eBooks, discs) • Lightweight and fast performance • Simple and intuitive egui GUI • Batch processing and queue management • Right-click integration with file manager
📖 Summary: FMX is a free, open-source media converter built with Rust, offering a user-friendly egui GUI for converting various file types including video, audio, images, documents, and discs. It supports batch processing, system-wide integration via right-click context menus, and provides presets for popular devices and platforms.
